name: cueline
description: Real-time interview copilot: live transcript, question detection and streamed, resume-grounded answers.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w web && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
